course.title: Practical Tagalog for Adult
course.goal: Develop practical Tagalog skills from A0 to A2 for handling everyday life independently.

stages.title: Sound Foundation
stages.goal: Recognize the basic sounds of Tagalog and attempt to pronounce simple words from their spelling.

lessons.title: Tagalog Sounds
lessons.goal: Recognize and pronounce the basic Tagalog vowels and consonants.

stages.title: Everyday Basics
stages.goal: Handle basic everyday reactions, needs, misunderstandings, requests, and simple interactions.

lessons.title: Hello and Introductions
lessons.goal: Greet someone and give a very simple introduction.

lessons.title: Yes, No, and Okay
lessons.goal: Respond to simple questions and situations.

lessons.title: Thanks, Sorry, and Goodbye
lessons.goal: Use essential polite expressions in everyday interactions.

lessons.title: I Don't Understand
lessons.goal: Tell someone you do not understand and ask them to repeat or slow down.

lessons.title: Me, You, and Them
lessons.goal: Refer to yourself and other people in simple everyday sentences.

lessons.title: Eating
lessons.goal: Talk about eating and basic food needs.

lessons.title: Drinking
lessons.goal: Talk about drinking and basic drink needs.

lessons.title: I Want
lessons.goal: Express what you want and ask what another person wants.

lessons.title: I Don't Want
lessons.goal: Refuse or express that you do not want something.

lessons.title: Can I?
lessons.goal: Ask for permission and understand simple permission responses.

lessons.title: Please Help Me
lessons.goal: Ask another person for basic help.
